data.change_summary: Patched the two pending amendments in place: comammox now decrements the shared running alkalinity budget in `nitrogen_cycle.rs` so the bookkeeping matches the DO budget and is ready for future downstream consumers, and `StageTrace` now skips `BudgetMetric` allocation unless budget tracking is active. I also added engine unit tests covering the new metric-gating behavior and kept a debug assertion on the running alkalinity budget to document the intended invariant until denitrification or other later consumers use it directly.
outstanding_risks: `alkalinity_produced_meq` remains a zero-valued placeholder until denitrification work lands; the return-path interface is prepared, but production is still not implemented.

A broader `cargo test -p tank_core --tests` sweep still fails in `save_load_with_active_cycle_state` at `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs:340`; that pre-existing save/load determinism issue remains unresolved in this stage.

steps.description: Inspect the current nitrogen-cycle and tracing implementations around the two pending amendments and confirm the exact failure surfaces.
Update the nitrification bookkeeping so comammox also debits the shared running alkalinity budget, and gate `StageTrace` budget-metric allocation on active budget tracking.
Add targeted unit coverage for the new `StageTrace` behavior, run formatting, and rerun focused plus broader validation to confirm the amendments and record remaining out-of-scope failures.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --tests` was rerun; all touched surfaces passed, and the suite still exposed the existing `save_load_with_active_cycle_state` failure in `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs:340`.
